answer: Price identity bonds on a convex curve: the first mask from a provenance costs one coin, the tenth costs a hundred — ferrous links, forged indivisible, never loanable between masks, so no farm pools one hoard across its heads. Keep each bond an ember, restoked every epoch with fresh independently signed work, or it cools off the ledger. One proven clone drags its whole bond-chain like rust through iron, and the farm's mass is karst: solid above, hollow beneath — one probe sinks it. Every new head buys less pooling and pays a steeper bond, so attack cost grows super-linearly.
